title: Work With: search the grid
description: Template (T10.2). The most common GeneXus screen: a Work With list with a filter. Logs in, opens the list, types a value in the filter, runs the search and checks that the grid shows rows with that value and that no stack trace or SQL error reached the screen. It only READS data. Use a value you know exists (a code from your test data). If your list searches on Enter, replace the search click with a press step. Replace every REPLACE_* value. See templates/routines/README.md.

lintSuppress.reason: The logout is the teardown of the included login routine.

steps.label: No request is pending (GeneXus loads the grid with an event)
We are on the list, not bounced to the login
Leave the field (GeneXus validates on blur)
Wait for the grid to refresh
The grid shows at least one row
The first row shows the value searched
No stack trace, exception class or SQL error on screen
